entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Regression] CA1825: False positive on .NET 11 Preview1 #82484
  • [Regression] IDE0370: False positive on unconstrained generic on .NET 11 Preview1 #82483
  • [Regression] IDE0031: False positive on .NET 11 Preview1 #82482
  • ReportAnalyzer should report when analyzers don't support concurrent execution #82480
  • XamlTextViewCreationListener assumes views have IVsTextView #82479
  • Add two new values to `SourceHashAlgorithm` enum #82478
  • VS Code: ArgumentOutOfRangeException when typing ignored preprocessor directive #82476
  • VS Code: System.UriFormatException when typing shebang directive #82475
  • `nameof` of `Color Color` in field initializer results in "Unable to determine specific cause of the failure." #82474
    18.5
  • Question: Setting build configuration in Roslyn LSP #82473
  • "Async Quick Fix" generates incompatible "async Task" event handlers instead of "async void" #82471

Closed

  • Capture source generator statistics #59176
    Backlog
  • ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true produces nondeterministic source paths by default #55860
    Backlog
  • Consider optimizing constrained calls to base methods on readonly struct in some cases #66365
    Backlog
  • Unnecessary defensive copy on `readonly struct` when performing a constrained call #76288
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11519.245 #82467

    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next

  • Rename HasUnionAttribute property #82461

Updated
